summary: Bind service ports to 127.0.0.1 when only a local reverse proxy needs them
Every public route must sit behind authentication; an anonymous request returns 302/401/403
Never commit secrets or edit credential files
Tokens are read-only and scoped to the repos they need
Do not ship a default or placeholder password for a service; require it from the environment
Validate redirect targets; never redirect to an unvalidated URL
Pass values to SQL as bound parameters; never build a query by string formatting
Do not run a subprocess with shell=True on untrusted input; pass an argument list
Verify a webhook signature with a constant-time comparison before acting on the payload
A unit of work commits or rolls back as one; no side-effecting commit, no partial write
Validate and bound external input before it reaches storage or logic
Handle the None/empty path explicitly; do not assume presence
Respect schema constraints; keep the read model and the event log consistent
Code must match its docstring / documented contract
Bound dependency versions; an open range lets a fresh resolve break a working build
Never replace innerHTML in a WS/SSE/polling loop; update textContent only
Every async operation has a loading and an error state
Never commit directly to the default branch; use a feature branch and a reviewed merge
